source_question_selection: Exactly the 300 source_index values and order in the saved confirmatory Aletheia requests.jsonl.

experiment_1.method: BM25 plus all-MiniLM-L6-v2 dense retrieval, equal-weight reciprocal rank fusion, constant=60, K=80
experiment_1.bm25_query: Original question text, lowercased alphanumeric tokenization matching the confirmatory runner.
experiment_1.ranking_ties: Stable descending score, original corpus order breaks ties, matching the preceding 89-question RRF test.

experiment_2.method: Tool-calling ReAct baseline; search_memory performs BM25 over the same full pinned memory store.
experiment_2.pilot_projection: Mean actual pilot question cost multiplied by 300; proceed only when <= $0.55.

audit_flags: Retained; no question is excluded or relabelled.
